findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 319 requests to 69 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 13.1 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 7.5 MB (57%) came from third-party domains, 2.3 MB of it from services classified as tracking (163 requests).

30 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), bidr.io (Beeswax, advertising), bidswitch.net (Iponweb (BidSwitch), advertising), casalemedia.com (Index Exchange, advertising), creativecdn.com (RTB House, advertising), criteo.com (Criteo, advertising).
86 cookies were set by third-party domains (137 cookies in total).
